changelog:
HealthClaw Skill - Initial Release

- Stream Apple Health data (heart rate, HRV, sleep, steps) from iPhone/Watch to OpenClaw via webhook server.
- Reliable pairing flow with secure, time-limited token system for initial connection.
- Automatic, background data sync with deduplication and append-only local storage.
- Supports both single-user and new multi-user modes, with isolated data directories.
- Offers easy setup guides for webhook hosting, public URL exposure (Tailscale, Cloudflare, ngrok), and pairing.
- Includes API references for syncing, pairing, and user management.
summary: Stream and sync iPhone/Apple Watch HealthKit data via a local webhook server for AI analysis, recovery scoring, and health anomaly alerts.
